name: Trametinib
mechanism: Reversible allosteric inhibitor of MEK1 and MEK2, blocking ERK activation downstream of BRAF; combined with dabrafenib in BRAF V600E-mutant NSCLC.
keyToxicities: Retinal pigment epithelial detachment and retinal vein occlusion
monitoring: LVEF assessment at baseline and periodically
interactions: Not a major CYP substrate; few pharmacokinetic interactions.
resistance: MAPK reactivation and parallel pathway activation, as for dabrafenib.
